title.purpose: Card titles and dense-surface headings (CardTitle default).

eyebrow.purpose: Scoped mono kicker — landing sections and dense-card column labels only, never generic section scaffolding.

micro.purpose: Dense mono micro-labels: judge gate chips, stage-rail labels, clip timestamps. The smallest legal step.

motion.name: ease-signature
motion.purpose: Entrance/rise motion on the landing (anim-rise, word-rise).

motion.name: duration-product
motion.purpose: Workspace state transitions; state-conveying only, reduced-motion alternatives mandatory.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Action Blue fill — the one interactive channel; hover dims, press nudges 1px.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.5 0.115 252)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0.005 84)); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.5 0.115 252)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.5 0.115 252)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.5 0.115 252)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; background: var(--background, oklch(0.98 0.004 84)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.028 258)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.9 0.008 255)); border-radius: 0.5rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.945 0.005 82)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.5 0.115 252)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.5 0.115 252)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Signal Badge
components.description: The amber channel: the engine found heat — never interactive.
components.css: .ds-badge-signal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; background: var(--signal, oklch(0.55 0.118 70)); color: var(--signal-foreground, oklch(0.985 0.005 84)); border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 0.75rem/1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-heat { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-heat-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; background: var(--heat-4, oklch(0.55 0.2 35)); color: var(--heat-paper, oklch(0.985 0.005 84)); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border-radius: 9999px; font: 400 0.6875rem/1.2 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-heat-track { display: block; width: 2.5rem; height: 0.375rem; background: var(--muted, oklch(0.945 0.005 82)); border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-heat-bar { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--heat-4, oklch(0.55 0.2 35)); border-radius: 9999px; }

components.description: Terminal-verb confirmation (s40): card-white on hairline, message + optional blue link-back; role=status, auto-clears at 6s, entrance halts under reduced motion.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background: var(--card, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.028 258)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.9 0.008 255)); border-radius: 0.625rem; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px oklch(0.24 0.028 258 / 0.08); } .ds-toast-action { background: none; border: none; padding: 0; color: var(--primary, oklch(0.5 0.115 252)); font: 500 0.875rem/1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toast-action:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A calm, light desk of paper and navy ink where a vigilant engine delivers what it found — and heat rises off the page exactly where something is worth acting on. Color is never decoration; it is a channel: blue means you act, amber-bronze means the engine found heat. The landing page is the same DNA after dark — near-black ink-navy with amber as the marketing accent — because both surfaces share one token set.
keyCharacteristics: Light-first workspace: paper base, navy ink, white cards, hairline borders
Two-channel color doctrine: action-blue (interactive) vs bronze-amber (signal)
Thermal heat grading worn as word-in-pill — glanceable, colorblind-proof
One sans family (Geist) at a tight product scale; mono for data/eyebrow labels
Flat by default; depth from tonal layering, not shadows
Dark-cinematic landing sharing the same tokens (.dark scope, never the root)

rules.name: The Two-Channel Rule
rules.body: Blue = you act; amber = the engine found heat. Neither color ever does the other's job, and no third accent exists.

rules.name: The Word-In-Pill Rule
rules.body: Heat is never color alone: the band word sits inside the pill, the exact score demotes to the tooltip. Any new grading surface reuses this grammar.

rules.name: The AA-Executable Rule
rules.body: Every named token pairing is pinned by tokens-contrast.test.ts; a failing pairing does not ship.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that updates sets tabular-nums so digits never jitter.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: No second display face, ever. Contrast comes from weight and the mono.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; depth is tonal (white-on-paper) or a state response — never an ambient drop shadow under every card.

rules.name: The Four-Verbs Rule
rules.body: Removal-shaped actions use exactly one verb per meaning, everywhere: Dismiss = a judgment that teaches the engine (item survives, reversible); Delete = destroy the data (confirm, refused while referenced); Reject = terminal verdict on a draft; Remove = take out of a working set (nothing destroyed, nothing learned). A delete that secretly dismisses, or vice versa, is a defect.

dos: Do keep the two channels pure: Action Blue for anything clickable, Bronze Signal for anything the engine flagged.
Do reuse the HeatGrade grammar (word-in-pill + magnitude bar) for any new score or grade.
Do keep skeletons on Muted Wash and write empty states as tutorials with a one-click seeded example.
Do run motion at 150-250ms, ease-out, state-conveying only, with reduced-motion alternatives.
Do keep the primary action visually dominant on every surface - the 10-second rule.

Pass the squint test before shipping a surface: blur your eyes and exactly one focal point per section should survive. If two elements fight for the eye, demote one — hierarchy is weight and placement, not a second accent color (founder-ratified, session 38).
donts: Don't dress the workspace as enterprise-fintech corporate - no shields, world maps, or gold-on-navy.
Don't darken the workspace: near-black command-center HUDs are the landing's register only.
Don't ship spam-cannon marketing mechanics: fake urgency, synthetic countdowns, guilt buttons, manufactured scarcity, gamification.
Don't use amber/signal on interactive chrome or blue on signal badges.
Don't use side-stripe borders, gradient text, glassmorphism-as-default, or an eyebrow kicker above every section.
Don't convey any state by color alone - words and attributes carry it.
Don't add ambient drop shadows under cards; tonal white-on-paper is the elevation system.
